## Constitutional functions[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Finance_Minister_of_Malta&action=edit&section=1)]

The finance minister has an important constitutional role. This constitution assigns the exclusive competence to the finance minister to initiate a legislative bill on financial measures. This means that financial measures cannot be introduced through a private member's bills amongst others. Furthermore, the constitution assigns the duty to the finance minister to lay before the[House of Representatives](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/House_of_Representatives_of_Malta)not later than thirty days after, the commencement of each financial year estimates of the revenues and expenditure of Malta for that year.
